representative_papers.title: HairGPT: Strand-as-Language Autoregressive Modeling for Realistic 3D Hairstyle Synthesis
representative_papers.problem: Hair generation entangles global topology with local texture obscuring semantic organization
representative_papers.approach: Strand-centric framework treating strands as primitives with spatial and structural decoupling
representative_papers.contribution: Compositional hairstyle synthesis across rare complex and stylized domains with semantic control

representative_papers.title: Interactive Yarn-level Knitwear with Nested Douglas-Rachford Splitting
representative_papers.problem: Yarn-level knitwear simulation is prohibitively expensive due to high DOF and non-convex coupling
representative_papers.approach: Nested Douglas-Rachford splitting decoupling non-convex variational energy subproblems
representative_papers.contribution: Stable high-resolution knitwear simulation via convexification and theoretically grounded metrics

representative_papers.title: Efficient Fur and Hair Multiple Scattering Using Volumetric Approximation
representative_papers.problem: Multiple scattering in dense hair/fur expensive and prior approximations fail, appearing dry or blurred
representative_papers.approach: Volumetric approximation as anisotropic participating medium with explicit fiber for direct lighting
representative_papers.contribution: 7-10x faster than path tracing, reproducing rich scattering appearance under varied lighting

representative_papers.title: High-Fidelity 4D Cloth Capture Pipeline with a Two-Level Pattern
representative_papers.problem: High-fidelity cloth capture requires resolving fine wrinkles, large deformation, and self-occlusion simultaneously
representative_papers.approach: Two-level marker pattern with physics-based optimization deforming template to match captured geometry
representative_papers.contribution: 1 mm spatial resolution 4D cloth capture with temporal coherence via keypoint triangulation and mesh deformation
